Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean.purpose: Actual dot-product matrix multiplication used by Matrix.semiring natural powers.

Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Derivative.le.purpose: Actual formal derivative and coefficient derivative formula.
